passageNote: The full barrel-bilge narration (203 spoken characters): a question hook, a named reveal ('the bilge'), a quick explanation and a payoff line. It is short, has suspense, a reveal and a light punchline, and each take can drive the real video for comparison.
modelNote: Multilingual v2 accepts SSML break tags (v3/v4 do not) and is the API default. If the chosen voice needs more playful delivery, a second round can try eleven_v3/eleven_v4 with [[tone ...]] audio tags.
settingsNote: The same for every voice. Lower stability than the 0.5 default allows more expressive range; style adds personality; speed stays at 1.0 (no artificial speed change).
